# Test fixtures — GE200 `.mo` presets

The two files in this directory are real Mooer GE200 single-preset exports used
only to verify the GE200 `.mo` serialization layout:

- `ge200-clean.mo` — "ANTO CLEAN" (community preset, Anto Addabbo).
- `ge200-lead.mo` — "LEAD LIVEPLAYRO" (free lead-solo preset download).

They are functional binary device data, not creative works; they are included
in minimal form (two files) solely so the reader/writer can be checked against
real device output.
